items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I was raised with my Black grandparents

ctx.x: What Black has to do... Like, in my case, it was all around me. I was raised with my Black grandparents, and I was about seven, and then I'd go downtown with my Creole grandparents and I'd see all this intrigue(?) with Whites. Like, kids would meet one another in the street, you'd see a bunch of kids playing, and you'd go over there to join them. All of them would be (?) playing tops, or they're throwing [t'rowin']...pitchin' to the line with coins or something And you'd go in and join two or three kids... And it…
